points.heading: Designing for users
points.summary: Design purposeful, functional, appealing products for themselves and other users based on design criteria.

points.heading: Generating and sharing ideas
points.summary: Generate, develop, model and communicate ideas by talking, drawing, using templates and mock-ups, and using ICT.

points.heading: Choosing tools and equipment
points.summary: Select from and use a range of tools and equipment for practical tasks such as cutting, shaping, joining and finishing.

points.heading: Choosing materials
points.summary: Select from and use a wide range of materials and components, including construction materials, textiles and ingredients, by their characteristics.

points.heading: Exploring and evaluating products
points.summary: Explore and evaluate existing products, and judge their own ideas and products against design criteria.

points.heading: Strong, stiff, stable structures
points.summary: Build structures, exploring how they can be made stronger, stiffer and more stable.

points.heading: Levers, sliders, wheels and axles
points.summary: Explore and use mechanisms such as levers, sliders, wheels and axles in their products.

points.heading: A healthy and varied diet
points.summary: Use the basic principles of a healthy and varied diet to prepare dishes.

points.heading: Where food comes from
points.summary: Understand where food comes from.
